scope_note: Provider recognition does not verify every item, quotation, locator, interpretation, or generated claim. Exact source-to-claim review remains required.

providers.name: SuttaCentral
providers.use_for: Early Buddhist texts, parallels, and identified modern translations.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact discourse or verse page, language, translator, and locator.

providers.name: 84000: Translating the Words of the Buddha
providers.use_for: Translations from the Tibetan Buddhist canon.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact translation page, Toh identifier when available, section, and translator team information.

providers.name: BDK America — English Tripitaka
providers.use_for: English translations from the Chinese Buddhist canon and related East Asian collections.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact work, translator, publication, and page or section.

providers.name: Lotsawa House
providers.use_for: Translations of Tibetan Buddhist texts across lineages.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact author, translator, title, tradition or lineage context, and page section.

providers.name: Tergar Meditation Community
providers.use_for: Official public teachings and practice guidance associated with Mingyur Rinpoche and Tergar.
providers.item_rule: Use only public material, name the teacher and program, and respect transmission or participation requirements.

providers.name: Samye Institute
providers.use_for: Public teachings and practice resources associated with Phakchok Rinpoche and Samye Institute.
providers.item_rule: Identify the teacher, article or course, date when relevant, and any practice prerequisites.

providers.name: Samye Mandala
providers.use_for: Public Dharma activities and teachings within the Samye Mandala context.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact public teaching and do not reproduce restricted practice instructions.

providers.name: Kagyu Office — Official Website of the 17th Gyalwang Karmapa
providers.use_for: Public teachings and official materials associated with the 17th Gyalwang Karmapa and Kagyu Office.
providers.item_rule: Cite the exact teaching title, date, speaker, and relevant section or timestamp.
